scope: Actual Next route handler and database/service logic using isolated MySQL tables; provider transport captured, no browser or real AI inference

results.name: Ordinary users cannot change media settings and rejected writes preserve configuration
Invalid switches, voices, missing/disabled models and mismatched capabilities are rejected atomically
Each capability can be disabled and enabled independently through the actual settings handler
Disabled image, recording and already connected voice turns stop before provider requests or charging
Changing all model bindings and voice affects the next actual service invocation without a process restart
Disabled bound model makes the corresponding public capabilities unavailable
Replacing the default model clears the previous default and the next ordinary chat uses the replacement
Site settings persist and appear in the public bootstrap without replacing media or payment configuration

cleanup: All isolated tables removed; production configuration and accounts unchanged
